title: LinkNest – Knowledge Management Platform
problem: Managing bookmarks and digital resources across multiple platforms is often disorganized and inefficient.
impact: Built a full-stack platform with collections, search, favorites, archives, and analytics for efficient resource management.

title: Smart Notes App
problem: Users need a secure and accessible way to manage notes online.
impact: Developed a MERN note management app with authentication and cloud-based note storage.

title: BioVault – Secure Biomedical Data Portal
problem: Sensitive biomedical data requires secure access and controlled management.
impact: Created a secure portal with authentication and role-based access for protected data handling.

title: IngreGenius – Recipe Recommendation Platform
problem: Finding recipes from available ingredients can be time-consuming.
impact: Built a recipe discovery platform with ingredient-based search and smart filtering.
